about_the_game:
This game is a fresh take on the classic brick-breaker formula, enhanced with rogue-like elements that make every run unique. Break blocks, keep your balls in play, and choose upgrades that shape your strategy as you progress.

Each session offers different paths and challenges, giving you the freedom to experiment with upgrades and discover powerful synergies. While the focus is on fast-paced arcade action, there are also quirky random events to keep things unpredictable and fun.

Core Gameplay

  • Break through walls of blocks while keeping your balls in play.

  • Level up as you progress to unlock new choices.

  • Select from a variety of upgrades to strengthen your balls and customize your playstyle.

  • Experiment with different combinations of upgrades to find powerful synergies.

Replayability

  • Rogue-like elements ensure that no two runs feel the same.

  • Easy to pick up and play, but with depth for players who enjoy chasing high scores.

Whether you’re looking for quick arcade fun or a game with endless replayability, this brick-breaker with a twist offers both simplicity and variety.
